# Local And Generated Files

This repo keeps a small set of machine-specific or generated files out of git on purpose.

## Generated

- `zsh/.zsh/completions/` is regenerated by `scripts/gen-completions`
- `firefox/.mozilla/firefox/` is Firefox runtime data
- `__pycache__/` is Python bytecode output

## Local Overrides

- Prefer a `*.local.*` file for machine-specific overrides when the package already expects one
- Keep those files untracked; `.gitignore` already covers the common `*.local.*` config suffixes
- If a tracked file needs local edits, use `git update-index --skip-worktree <file>` instead of creating repo noise

## Current Exception

- `codex/.codex/config.toml` is tracked here for shared defaults, but can be hidden locally with `skip-worktree` if you do not want to commit local edits
